name: voice_oohs
description: Jewelbox 31 Voice Oohs: a vintage 1950s studio microphone - the chrome boom arm (with a counterweight ball) is the striker; the art-deco chrome capsule with horizontal grille slots sits on a gold yoke at its right end, the boom clamps onto a chrome stand with a black cast base and a coiled cable, and a red ON-AIR lamp glows above.
